parsed.notes:
The candidate-qualification section has no optional heading; inline 'strong plus' and 'helpful but not required' apply only to their respective bullets.
The required expertise alternatives are each labeled required under the guide's treatment of named alternatives. The required LLM mention takes precedence over the later strong-plus mention.
Production ML deployment, monitoring, maintenance, and ML infrastructure are mapped literally to AI deployment, observability, MLOps, and AI Infrastructure.
Estimation, ranking, prediction, and decision-making are retained as unmapped techniques explicitly named in the applied-ML qualification; prediction is not assumed to mean time-series forecasting.
Responsibilities and motivational statements are not treated as independent skill requirements. Logistics, marketplaces, and delivery-platform experience are excluded as domain knowledge.
The degree label takes the highest level named, although bachelor's and master's degrees are also accepted.
